name: Farm Fresh Berhad
summary: Farm Fresh Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, marketing, and sale of cow's milk and plant-based related products in Malaysia, Australia, Singapore, Philippines, Cambodia, and internationally. The company's products portfolio includes fresh milk, flavored milk, farm fresh grow, yoghurt and yoghurt drinks, goat milk, and other products; plant-based alternatives, such as oat and almond milk; organic A2 milk, kurma milk, lactose-free milk, and plant based beverages; milk powder; and ready-to-drink milk.
